name: Pr Pitch
description: Produces a media pitch email with news hook, story angle, expert availability, and supporting data using PR pitch structure. Use when the user asks to write a PR pitch, pitch a story to journalists, create a media pitch, draft a press pitch email, or prepare outreach to media outlets about a newsworthy announcement. Do NOT use for influencer collaboration briefs (use influencer-brief), sales outreach emails (use cold-outreach-sequence), or social media content (use social-media-strategy).
